commits.author: Lyuben Blagoev
commits.message:
Bump commons-lang to 3.18.0 to fix CVE-2025-48924

Upgraded from vulnerable commons-lang:commons-lang:2.6 to
org.apache.commons:commons-lang3:3.18.0 to address the
Uncontrolled Recursion vulnerability (StackOverflowError on
long inputs via ClassUtils.getClass).
